cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: go straight · /ɡoʊ streɪt/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To continue forward without turning. Go straight to the next street.
straight ahead · /streɪt əˈhɛd/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Directly in front of you. The store is straight ahead.
go past · /ɡoʊ pæst/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To continue beyond a person or place. Go past the school, then stop.
turn around · /tɝn əˈraʊnd/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To turn so that you face the other direction. Turn around. The bus stop is behind you.
keep going · /kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To continue moving or doing something. Keep going until you see the school.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.

articulation.label: left
articulation.alt: left: /l/ → /ɛ/ → /f/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
